faq.title: Questions, answered.
faq.a1: A 0.5% Ferry fee, shown on its own line before you sign. The network fee is covered by Ferry, and you don't need a gas token. The rate is locked for 90 seconds while you review.
faq.a2: $1 to $200 per payout, and up to $500 a day.
faq.a3: Usually under a minute. You watch every step live, with a timestamp. Now and then the payout partner reviews a payout, which can take up to 24 hours.
faq.q4: What happens if a payout fails?
faq.a4: Your USDT goes back to your wallet automatically. You'll see "Refunded" with the amount and a short reference like Ref FRY-8K2Q.
faq.q5: Which countries can I cash out to?
faq.a5: Nigeria (174 banks and fintechs), Kenya (M-Pesa, Airtel Money and banks), Uganda (MTN and Airtel) and Tanzania (banks and mobile money). You can send from anywhere in the world.
faq.a6: No. Money goes straight from your wallet to a licensed payout partner. Refunds go back to your wallet.
